messages:
maya: Heads up — running into a weird parity bug in the Node SDK JSON mode when auth refresh triggers a retry. Our sample app's function-calling flow used to return nested objects, but after an auth retry the nested field becomes a stringified JSON and the schema validator rejects it.

ryan: can you paste the schema + the raw failing payload? does the python sdk reproduce this?

maya: minimal repro: Node SDK v0.9.3, sampleapp v0.4.5. Python (v0.9.3) behaves correctly and returns native objects. Node appears to double-serialize the body when the retry queue is used.

maya: ```
# schema (toy)
{"type":"object","properties":{"task":{"type":"string"},"result":{"type":"object","properties":{"score":{"type":"number"}}},"required":["task","result"]}
```

maya: failing response (what validator receives):
```json
"{
  \"task\": \"summarize\",
  \"result\": \"{\\\"score\\\": 0.87}\"
}"
```

maya: notice result is a string containing an escaped JSON object rather than an object. Validator says result is not an object.

jen: sounds like the retry wrapper stringified the body to stash it in the queue and we forgot to parse when rehydrating. I remember an old telemetry helper that did the same for safe logging.

maya: traced to auth/refresh middleware. It calls JSON.stringify before enqueueing, but on rehydrate we reattach the serialized body without JSON.parse. Python's retry keeps the body as a JS object (well, a Python dict) so parity is broken.

ryan: paste the log snippet so we can see exact strings around queue/enqueue/rehydrate.

maya: logs: ```
[2024-10-03T17:22:10.123Z] INFO retry: queued request {method: POST, body: '{"task":"summarize","result":{"score":0.87}}'}
[2024-10-03T17:22:10.456Z] INFO retry: rehydrating body from queue -> body: '{"task":"summarize","result":"{\"score\":0.87}"}'
```

jen: yep, queue stores stringified body and rehydrate doesn't restore nested objects. Two quick fixes: 1) don't stringify if content-type is application/json and store native object; 2) if storing string, JSON.parse on rehydrate for application/json. Also add an integration test that forces an auth refresh mid-response.

ryan: temp workaround for sampleapp: attach a post-validate hook that tries to JSON.parse result when typeof result === 'string'. ugly but will unblock onboarding. also add a unit test to catch parity.

maya: workaround implemented in sampleapp: ```js
if (typeof res.result === 'string') { try { res.result = JSON.parse(res.result) } catch (e) { /* leave as-is if parse fails */ } }
```
but we'll revert once SDK patch lands.

devex-bot: Created issue REDWOOD-ISSUE-1289: "node-sdk: auth retry path double-serializes structured outputs (JSON mode parity)" — https://redwood/issues/1289

jen: opening PR to node-sdk. Plan: detect content-type application/json, avoid JSON.stringify in retry queue, and add integration tests that exercise functioncall schemas with nested objects and an auth refresh. Also audit other middleware that may stringify for logging/telemetry.

ryan: ping me on the PR for the test harness. we should also add a cross-sdk smoke test in CI that compares python/node behavior for structured output when auth retry occurs.

ci-bot: CI job failing: integration/structured-output-parity (sampleapp) — job id 4523. Marking flaky=false.

maya: pushed a repro branch with failing test and logs attached to the issue.

jen: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/redwood-node-sdk/pull/234 (WIP). Notes: remove stringify on enqueue, parse on rehydrate fallback, add tests, add docs note. Leaving TODO to audit telemetry wrappers.

maya: will keep the sampleapp workaround until PR merges. Adding a short blurb to the JSON-mode docs to warn about auth-retry parity and the temporary post-validate fix so newcomers don't assume model/schema is broken.

ryan: agree — onboarding friction here is real; people copy sampleapp and hit schema errors and think the model is misbehaving. docs blurb + CI parity test should reduce future surprises.

jen: adding docs note and referencing REDWOOD-ISSUE-1289. will add the parity integration test to the SDK CI matrix.

maya: closing thread for now; will update when PR merges. Thanks! :thumbsup:
